The drawing shows a central phosphorus atom with four substituents:

- a double bond to O (P=O)
- a single bond to OH
- two single bonds to OBn groups

Bn (benzyl) expands to CH2-phenyl, so each OBn is OCc1ccccc1. The molecule is dibenzyl phosphate.

SMILES: O=P(O)(OCc1ccccc1)OCc1ccccc1
